method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Blech decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Blech pages, then filtered for lifegain and Pests, Bats, Insects, Snakes and Spiders. Game Changers excluded.
summary: Secrets of Strixhaven was built around Blech's Pests, and recent Blech lists are full of them. Teacher's Pest, Pest Mascot and Shopkeeper's Bane are in most lists. The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

sets.name: EDHREC Recommendations
